name: lobehub
title_zh: 雇、排班、写周报，把散落的 AI 助手编成一支 7×
tagline_zh: 你手上已经有七八个 Agent，却还在一个个手动点开、手动喂上下文、手动记它们干过什么。
tagline_en: You already have a pile of agents and no idea what they did today. LobeHub keeps a roster, assigns shifts, and.
desc_en: 🤯 LobeHub is your Chief Agent Operator, organizing your agents into 7×24 operations by hiring, scheduling, and reporting on your entire AI team.
why_zh: 别处是「再给你一个 Agent」，它是「给你一个管 Agent 的岗位」——招聘、排班。
why_en: Everyone else ships another agent; this ships the operator role above them. Hiring, scheduling and reporting are separate.
limit_zh: 它是编排层不是模型层，Agent 的推理能力仍取决于你接的模型和 API Key；本地部署要自己扛 Postgres。
limit_en: It orchestrates, it doesn't reason — agent quality still depends on your models and API keys. Self-hosting means running Postgres, object storage.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Hire, schedule, and report on your whole AI agent team
